notes: CREATIVE_BATCH_4.md CB4-S/4.2. About 30-35k requests plus the event walk, 3.5-5 h wall. Same stop, refusal, cap, guard and terminal-state rules as q0081 (status series_fetch_complete or not_run_deadline). Additionally refuses until the committed docs/research_lab/seals/cb4_series_rules.json equals this code's cadence/matching rule hashes (create it with scripts/run_cb4.py series-rules and commit it before this job can run). Resumable per walk window and per unit.
